summary.text: Dan Sena is a Democratic state representative who has represented the 37th Middlesex District since June 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He won the seat in a 2020 special election and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Sena, listed in legislative records and by Ballotpedia as Danillo Sena, won a 2020 special election for the 37th Middlesex District and assumed office on June 10, 2020.

He serves on the House Committees on Climate Action and Sustainability and on Intergovernmental Affairs and the Joint Committees on Agriculture and Fisheries and on Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities.
